items.title: CGTN (Chinese state media): The Sea We Call Home — Part Four: Farming the Sea
items.content_text: A larger boat carries smaller fishing boats farther offshore. Once they reach the fishing grounds, the smaller boats head out on their own. It is one way fishermen are adapting as catches closer to home become harder to sustain. For Feng Ping, whom we first met 12 years ago, life on the island Jinqing Dao has changed in many ways. Fishing is no longer his only livelihood.

items.title: CGTN (Chinese state media): Big Boats, Small Boats, Farther Seas
items.content_text: A large vessel carries fishermen, supplies and smaller fishing boats farther offshore. Once they reach the fishing grounds, the smaller boats head out on their own. Some fishermen dive into the water, while others fish with rods. This arrangement allows them to reach more distant fishing grounds and adapt to changing conditions at sea. How does this new way of fishing work?

items.title: CGTN (Chinese state media): Xi's Shenzhen visits show China's commitment to reform and opening up
items.content_text: In November 1991, China officially joined APEC. Thirty-five years later, China is bringing APEC to Shenzhen, the very place where China's opening up to the world began, and as global leaders gather to explore ways to advance development, the world will see China's opening up to the world taking on new dimensions.
